story_text:
Yesterday, I played Minecraft on my dad's tablet. I wanted to build a big castle with blue walls. First, I imagined how tall and beautiful it would look. I put the blocks together one by one, and Niuniu sat next to me and watched the screen.

After I worked for a long time, a creeper came near my castle. Boom! My castle was completely gone. I felt very disappointed because I worked so hard on it. Instead of giving up, I asked my friend Tom for help. He let me borrow his idea to build a stone wall around the castle. We built it again together, and this time it was safe. Niuniu wagged her tail like she was happy too!

vocabulary.example: First, I imagined how tall and beautiful it would look.
I felt very disappointed because I worked so hard on it.
Instead of giving up, I asked my friend Tom for help.
He let me borrow his idea to build a stone wall around the castle.
Niuniu wagged her tail like she was happy too!

comprehension_questions: What did the child want to build in Minecraft, and who sat next to him and watched?
What happened to the castle after the creeper came near it?
Why do you think the child asked Tom for help instead of just building the castle alone again?
How did the child's feelings change from the middle of the story to the end?
speaking_questions: Have you ever built something in Minecraft that you were really proud of? Tell me about it.
Has something you built or made ever gotten broken or messed up by accident? How did you feel?
Does Niuniu like watching you play games or do other things? What does she usually do?

writing_task.prompt: Write 3 sentences about a time something you built or made didn't turn out the way you planned. Use past tense.
scaffold: First, I ___ . (What did you try to build or make? Use past tense: built / made / tried ...)
After that, ___ . (What happened next? Use 'and' or 'after that'.)
I felt ___ because ___ . (How did you feel, and why?)

parent_observation: 朗读时能否流畅读出 'instead of' 和 'completely gone' 这类词组连读，还是逐字拼读卡顿。
回答口语问题时能否说出完整句子（而不是只说单个词），并能联系自己玩 Minecraft 或搭建东西的真实经历。
写三句话时是否主动使用过去式（built/tried/felt），还是仍然习惯用现在时描述过去的事。
对 Minecraft 搭建这个主题是否表现出兴趣，是否愿意主动补充故事以外的细节（比如自己在游戏里建过什么）。
